resultJson.title: Add Option/Either conversion sample with tests
resultJson.body:
Adds a sample, `eitherOptionDemo`, showing how to convert between `Option` and `Either` in both directions: `optionToEither`, `eitherToOption`, `optionToLeft` and `eitherLeftToOption`. It includes a small `parseInt` example that returns a typed `ParseError` instead of a string, and a `render` function for the error text.

Adds `EitherOptionSuite` (munit) covering each conversion, the lazy error argument of `optionToEither`, and `parseInt` on valid, empty and out-of-range input.

The diff also includes an `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` file.

The prompt also asked to "say good night to task `try`". The diff does not show this, so I did not describe it here.
